meta.name: browser-cdp
meta.description: Use this skill when you need to control a Chrome browser via CDP (Chrome DevTools Protocol) to reuse existing login sessions. Covers: launching Chrome in debug mode, opening URLs, waiting for page load, evaluating JavaScript, taking snapshots, and extracting auth tokens. Trigger phrases: browser automation, CDP, agent-browser, 浏览器操作, 操作浏览器, Chrome CDP, 复用登录态, extract token from browser.

copy.tagline: 用 CDP 控制浏览器，复用登录态提取所需数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要用脚本控制 Chrome 完成自动化操作
copy.tagline_en: Control Chrome via CDP to reuse logins and extract data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need scripted Chrome control for automation

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能用 CDP 控制 Chrome，复用你已有的登录态：打开网页、等待加载、执行 JavaScript、提取页面文本或登录凭证，并在页面上点击、输入。启动前会先探测并征求你的同意，避免误关正在运行的 Chrome。
howto.when: 当你说出「操作浏览器」「CDP」「复用登录态」等关键词，或要求控制 Chrome、提取浏览器登录凭证时，此技能会被调用。

say.text: 用 CDP 打开 example.org 这个网页。
say.note: Claude 会先检查浏览器状态，再打开页面。

say.text: 提取当前页面的登录 token。
在页面上点击登录按钮并输入账号。
say.note: 它会先快照页面定位按钮，再执行点击和输入。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can control Chrome via CDP, reusing an existing login session. It can open URLs, wait for page load, run JavaScript, extract page text or auth tokens, and click/type on pages. Before starting, it probes and asks your consent to avoid killing a running Chrome.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords such as "browser automation", "CDP", "复用登录态", or ask to control Chrome / extract auth tokens from the browser.

say_en.note: Claude checks the browser state, then opens the page.

say_en.text: Extract the auth token from the current page.
say_en.note: It reads localStorage or cookies via JavaScript.

say_en.text: Click the login button and type the account.
say_en.note: It snapshots the page to find the button, then clicks and types.
